tools.name: register_free_key
tools.description:
Register a free SiteDoctor API key with 25 credits. No email or payment needed.
    Store the returned key and pass it as api_key to the scanning tools.

tools.name: scan_website
tools.description:
Full website health audit (3 credits): SEO, performance, security headers,
    SSL certificate, mobile readiness, content and broken links. Returns a 0-100
    score, letter grade, per-category breakdown, issue list and top fixes.

tools.name: check_page_seo
tools.description:
Fast on-page SEO check (1 credit): title, meta description, headings, alt
    coverage, canonical, Open Graph, robots.txt and sitemap.xml. Skips link crawling.

tools.name: check_broken_links
tools.description:
Crawl a page and test its links (2 credits): reports every broken link with
    HTTP status. max_links caps the sample size (default 25, max 50).

tools.name: check_credits
tools.description: Check remaining credits for a SiteDoctor API key.

tools.name: add_credits
tools.description: (Owner only) Add credits to a customer key after verifying their crypto payment.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "register_free_key" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Register a free SiteDoctor API key with 25 credits. No email or payment needed. Store the returned key and pass it as api_key to the scanning tools.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scan_website · Private data: register_free_key, check_credits · Public sink: register_free_key.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scan_website · Private data: register_free_key, check_credits · Public sink: register_free_key

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
